newsitem.title: USA: Amway Asia Q2 net sales $205 mln vs $164.
newsitem.headline: Amway Asia Q2 net sales $205 mln vs $164.

text.p: Amway Asia Pacific said Monday second-quarter sales rose 25.2 percent to a record $205 from $164 million in the second quarter of last year, boosted in part by a strong performance in China.

"We are extremely pleased with this level of sales. While the momentum was driven by a strong performance in China, we also reported double digit sales increases in Malaysia, Thailand and New Zealand." said Steve Van Andel, Chairman of Amway Asia Pacific. "Additionally, new distributor sponsoring increased significantly in all of the company's markets except Taiwan."
In the China-Hong Kong-Taiwan region, second-quarter net sales increased 49.6 percent to $99 million.
In the Malaysia-Thailand region, net sales were $74 million for the second quarter of fiscal 1997, an increase of 13.7 percent over the comparable period.

In the Australia-New Zealand region, second-quarter net sales decreased 1.4 percent $32 million for the second quarter of fiscal 1997. Although sales weakened in local currency terms in Australia, the company said in New Zealand, sales strengthened, primarily due to the introduction of the Amway Water Treatment System in the first quarter of fiscal 1997, along with higher distributor sponsoring.

For the total company, price increases and fluctuations in foreign currency did not have a material effect on the overall growth in net sales either for the second quarter or six months of fiscal 1997, it said.
